name: geo_cos_sum_two_pi_div_seven
statement: : Real.cos (2 * Real.pi / 7) + Real.cos (4 * Real.pi / 7) + Real.cos (6 * Real.pi / 7) = -1 / 2
closed: Real.cos (2 * Real.pi / 7) + Real.cos (4 * Real.pi / 7) + Real.cos (6 * Real.pi / 7) = -1 / 2
informal: cos(2π/7) + cos(4π/7) + cos(6π/7) = −1/2 — multiply by 2 sin(π/7) ≠ 0 and telescope with 2 sin x cos y = sin(x+y) − sin(y−x), leaving sin(π) − sin(π/7); or take real parts of the sum of the 7th roots of unity.
type: Real.cos (2 * Real.pi / 7) + Real.cos (4 * Real.pi / 7) + Real.cos (6 * Real.pi / 7) = -1 / 2
